final_prompt:
Write the text of an Ujjwal Rail helpdesk FAQ answer.
Document: FAQ-13 "Is there a senior citizen discount?" (effective from 2025-06-01). Language: English.
Write each section below as 1-4 clear sentences for passengers, using ONLY the facts given.
Keep every number, amount, percentage, time, date and document ID exactly as given, using Western
digits (0-9) even in Hindi. Write dates in the YYYY-MM-DD form given. Do not add any other numbers,
rules, phone numbers, websites or contact details.
Sections (name: facts):
- "Answer": Passengers aged 60 or more get 40% off the base fare in SL, 3A and 2A if chosen at booking.
Schema: {"sections": [{"section": "<exact section name>", "text": str}]}

sections.text: Passengers who are 60 years old or older are eligible for a senior citizen discount. A discount of 40% off the base fare is applied in Sleeper Class (SL), Third AC (3A) and Second AC (2A) when the discount is selected at the time of booking. The discount is effective from 2025-06-01.
